titleZh: Claude 如何加速蛋白质设计与分析化学——15 个靶点打中 14 个，模型第一次主导了一轮真实湿实验战役
titleEn: How Claude is accelerating protein design and analytical chemistry
author: Anthropic Research
authorTitle: Anthropic 科学团队——设计由 Adaptyv Bio 与 Twist Bioscience 两家外部机构独立在湿实验室生产并验证
summary: Claude 自主跑完一轮蛋白设计战役，15 个靶点打中 14 个、命中率 22-35%，远超行业典型的 10-15%。
keyPoints: **命中率翻倍且自主完成**：多靶点模式 48 小时内 Mythos Preview 26.7%、Opus 4.8 22.6%，单靶点模式 35.1%，行业典型为 10-15%。
**人类只批权限不给指导**：启动后零科学/技术介入，Claude 自选位点、编排开源结构与共折叠模型、跑 in silico 优化并筛选候选。
**分析化学 23 分钟对上实验室四天**：只给原始文件和两句 prompt，纯度测得 96.4% vs 实验室 96.33%，且自查纠正了自己的误读。
insight: 看点不是蛋白本身，而是「模型当研究主管、人类只做批准与验证」这套工作流被公开成了可复制范式。

bilingual.en:
The pace of AI-enabled discoveries has quickened over the past few months. The bulk of these discoveries have been in areas where verification is relatively fast. In mathematics, for example, agents have begun to work their way through unsolved problems: [Erdős problems](https://openai.com/index/model-disproves-discrete-geometry-conjecture/) that have stood for decades are falling at a rate of several a month, and we recently shared how Claude improved on a longstanding lower bound on the [Riemann zeta function](https://www.anthropic.com/research/riemann-zeta).

AI models are also beginning to hasten progress in experimental fields where verifying the results is more complex and expensive, such as in the life sciences. In this post, we share the results of two experiments into Claude’s scientific capabilities. First, we present findings from our investigation into Claude’s performance on a protein design campaign, showing that Claude can design protein binders against a variety of targets as well as (or even better than) leading human experts. Second, we share how Claude Opus 5 performed on an analytical chemistry task, demonstrating how general-access models can support the routine and time-intensive aspects of research.
bilingual.zh:
过去几个月，AI 驱动的发现明显提速。这些发现大多集中在**验证相对快速**的领域。比如在数学上，agent 已经开始一路啃掉未解难题：那些悬置了数十年的 [Erdős 问题](https://openai.com/index/model-disproves-discrete-geometry-conjecture/)正以每月数个的速度倒下，我们最近也分享过 Claude 如何改进了 [黎曼 zeta 函数](https://www.anthropic.com/research/riemann-zeta) 的一个长期下界。

AI 模型也开始在**验证更复杂、更昂贵**的实验性领域加速进展，比如生命科学。本文分享我们针对 Claude 科研能力的两项实验结果。第一项，是我们对 Claude 在一次蛋白质设计战役中表现的调查发现——结果显示 Claude 设计针对多种靶点的蛋白结合剂，能达到甚至超过顶尖人类专家的水平。第二项，我们分享 Claude Opus 5 在一项分析化学任务上的表现，展示通用可得的模型如何支撑科研中那些例行且耗时的环节。

bilingual.en:
The protein design and analytical chemistry tasks described below are representative of the work that makes up some parts of the early stages of the drug development process. Accelerating these phases is one component of our much larger effort to speed up drug development end-to-end, many aspects of which have more to do with policy and operational bottlenecks than with improvements in core scientific capabilities.

The results that we’re sharing today were obtained with a combination of our Mythos and Opus models. While life science research tasks are currently blocked in our most capable model, one of our highest priorities is to launch an access program for scientists, and we expect to share more on this soon. In the meantime, Opus 5 remains our most capable generally available model.
bilingual.zh:
下文描述的蛋白质设计与分析化学任务，代表了药物研发流程早期阶段的一部分工作。加速这些阶段，只是我们「端到端加速药物研发」这一更大努力中的一个组成部分——而后者的许多环节，与政策和运营瓶颈的关系其实大过与核心科学能力提升的关系。

我们今天分享的结果，是用 Mythos 和 Opus 两类模型组合取得的。目前生命科学研究类任务在我们能力最强的模型上是被封禁的，而我们最高优先级的事项之一，就是为科学家推出一个访问计划，预计很快会有更多消息。在此期间，Opus 5 仍是我们通用可得的最强模型。

bilingual.en:
## **Claude designs proteins**

When we [announced Claude Mythos 5](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-fable-5-mythos-5), we shared that we were experimenting with the model to accelerate parts of the drug design process. As an ongoing part of this work, we have been investigating Claude’s ability to design minibinders for multiple protein targets. A minibinder is a small protein designed to latch tightly onto a target protein. Binding is how a large proportion of modern medicines work: they attach to a target and inhibit, activate, or deliver something to it. Designing a new binder (known as _de novo_ design) has historically taken protein engineers months of computation, optimization, and screening per target.

In recent years, machine-learning models that can design proteins and rank which are most likely to bind have greatly expedited the protein design process. But these models still generally require days (and often weeks) of laborious orchestration by computational experts. And although general reasoning models like Claude can help both experts and non-experts more efficiently design proteins computationally, validating that data in a wet lab (where scientists physically test chemicals, drugs, and other biological substances) still takes weeks.
bilingual.zh:
## **Claude 设计蛋白质**

在我们[发布 Claude Mythos 5](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-fable-5-mythos-5) 时曾提到，我们正在实验用该模型加速药物设计流程的部分环节。作为这项工作的持续组成部分，我们一直在考察 Claude 为多个蛋白靶点设计**微结合剂（minibinder）**的能力。微结合剂是一种被设计用来紧紧咬住目标蛋白的小蛋白。「结合」正是相当大一部分现代药物的作用机制：它们附着到某个靶点上，然后抑制它、激活它，或者向它投递某样东西。设计一个全新的结合剂（即所谓的 *de novo* 从头设计），历来需要蛋白工程师针对每个靶点花上数月的计算、优化和筛选。

近年来，那些能设计蛋白、并对哪些最可能结合进行排序的机器学习模型，已经大大加快了蛋白设计流程。但这些模型通常仍需要计算专家花费数天（往往是数周）的繁琐编排。而尽管像 Claude 这样的通用推理模型能帮助专家和非专家更高效地在计算层面设计蛋白，把这些数据放到湿实验室（科学家在其中对化学品、药物及其他生物物质做实际测试的地方）里验证，仍然要花上数周。

bilingual.en:
We have now received wet lab data back for the first of these experiments, a multi-arm protein design campaign against 15 targets using Claude Opus 4.8 and Mythos Preview. Our external evaluators, [Adaptyv Bio](https://www.adaptyvbio.com/) and [Twist Bioscience](https://www.twistbioscience.com/), independently produced and tested Claude’s designs in the lab, finding that of the 15 targets we designed against, Claude successfully designed binders against 14 of them. These include high-affinity binders1 against at least six targets, and binders matching or exceeding the best reported affinity against at least four targets. Affinity is a measure of how strongly a protein binds to its target; high-affinity binders are generally needed to achieve a therapeutic effect because they make the drug effective at lower doses, reducing the risk of side effects and the cost to manufacture them.

Mythos Preview and Opus 4.8 achieve overall hit rates—how many of the designs are, in fact, binders—of 26.7% and 22.6%, respectively, when designing against all targets simultaneously in a 48-hour session. 10 to 15% is typical in protein design campaigns today.2
bilingual.zh:
我们现在拿回了其中第一项实验的湿实验室数据：一次使用 Claude Opus 4.8 与 Mythos Preview、针对 **15 个靶点**的多臂（multi-arm）蛋白设计战役。我们的外部评估方 [Adaptyv Bio](https://www.adaptyvbio.com/) 和 [Twist Bioscience](https://www.twistbioscience.com/) 独立地在实验室里生产并测试了 Claude 的设计，结果发现：在我们设计针对的 15 个靶点中，**Claude 对其中 14 个成功设计出了结合剂**。这里面包括针对至少 6 个靶点的高亲和力结合剂[^1]，以及针对至少 4 个靶点、达到或超过已报道最佳亲和力的结合剂。亲和力衡量的是蛋白与其靶点结合的牢固程度；要达到治疗效果通常需要高亲和力结合剂，因为它们能让药物在更低剂量下起效，从而降低副作用风险和生产成本。

在 48 小时的一次会话中同时针对所有靶点做设计时，Mythos Preview 和 Opus 4.8 的**总体命中率**（即有多少设计确实是有效结合剂）分别达到 **26.7% 和 22.6%**。而当今蛋白设计战役的典型命中率是 10% 到 15%。[^2]

bilingual.en:
After assessing Claude’s ability to design against multiple targets, we wanted to understand whether having it focus on a single target at a time would improve its performance, especially given that this better represents the approach typically taken by a protein engineer. Indeed, we found that Mythos Preview achieves an overall hit rate of 35.1% when designing against each target separately using multiple 24-hour sessions.

Mythos Preview and Opus 4.8 achieve hit rates over 20% across a set of 15 targets, with target-level hit rates ranging from as high as 90% to as low as 0%.

This campaign was carried out with minimal human involvement3 beyond the information we provided Claude in our initial prompt ([link](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Anthropic/claude-protein-binder-design/tree/main)). We expect that in the hands of expert protein designers this approach would yield even stronger results, especially if they give Claude active guidance and feedback on intermediate results.
bilingual.zh:
在评估了 Claude 针对多靶点同时设计的能力之后，我们想弄清楚：让它一次只专注一个靶点，表现会不会更好——尤其考虑到这更贴近蛋白工程师通常采取的做法。结果确实如此：当 Mythos Preview 用多个 24 小时会话分别针对每个靶点设计时，**总体命中率达到 35.1%**。

> 图注：Mythos Preview 与 Opus 4.8 在 15 个靶点上的命中率均超过 20%，而单个靶点层面的命中率区间跨度极大——高至 90%，低至 0%。

这次战役中，除了我们在初始 prompt 里提供给 Claude 的信息（[链接](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Anthropic/claude-protein-binder-design/tree/main)）之外，**人类介入极少**[^3]。我们预计，如果交到专业蛋白设计师手上，这套方法会产出更强的结果——尤其是当他们对中间结果给予 Claude 主动的指导与反馈时。

bilingual.en:
#### **The campaign**

We began our protein design campaign by selecting multiple targets4 that are commonly used in protein design benchmarks, including all of Adaptyv Bio’s [BenchBB](https://www.adaptyvbio.com/blog/benchbb). Because these targets have been studied extensively, we can compare our results against published hit rates and affinities. We also chose two novel targets, [15-PGDH](https://proteinbase.com/collections/berlin-bio-x-adaptyv-15-pgdh-binder-design-competition) and [GDF-8](https://proteinbase.com/collections/gdf-8-challenge-results), from Adaptyv Bio’s most recent competitions to ensure Claude was able to design against targets without drawing upon pre-recorded successes in its training data or from online search (for all targets, we required Claude to check for and ensure that its designs were original).

We then prompted Claude to design protein binders against these targets in [Claude Science](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-science-ai-workbench). For this, we took two approaches. The first was a multi-target mode, where Claude designed against all targets simultaneously in a single Claude Science session. The second was a single-target mode, in which each session addressed one target and sessions for all targets ran in parallel.
bilingual.zh:
#### **这次战役**

我们的蛋白设计战役从选取多个靶点[^4]开始，这些都是蛋白设计基准中常用的靶点，包括 Adaptyv Bio 的全部 [BenchBB](https://www.adaptyvbio.com/blog/benchbb)。由于这些靶点已被广泛研究，我们可以把结果与已发表的命中率和亲和力做对照。我们还从 Adaptyv Bio 最近的竞赛中挑了两个**全新靶点**——[15-PGDH](https://proteinbase.com/collections/berlin-bio-x-adaptyv-15-pgdh-binder-design-competition) 和 [GDF-8](https://proteinbase.com/collections/gdf-8-challenge-results)——以确保 Claude 是在无法依赖训练数据中已记录的成功案例、也无法靠在线搜索抄答案的情况下完成设计的（对所有靶点，我们都要求 Claude 自查并确保其设计是原创的）。

随后我们在 [Claude Science](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-science-ai-workbench) 中提示 Claude 针对这些靶点设计蛋白结合剂。这里我们采取了两种路径。第一种是**多靶点模式**，Claude 在单个 Claude Science 会话中同时针对所有靶点做设计。第二种是**单靶点模式**，每个会话只处理一个靶点，所有靶点的会话并行运行。

我们在多靶点模式下运行 Opus 4.8 和 Mythos Preview，给予 48 小时的墙上时钟时间，以及最多 12,500 NVIDIA H100 小时的算力来运行专用的蛋白设计与折叠模型。我们还在单靶点模式下运行 Mythos Preview，每个靶点给 24 小时墙上时钟时间和最多 2,500 NVIDIA H100 小时算力。[^5]

为了模拟一次典型蛋白设计战役中可用的资源，我们给了 Claude 以下条件：

1.  一份详尽的蛋白设计 prompt[^6]，同样被放进 agent 上下文中；
2.  互联网访问权，以及一批蛋白设计相关的资源语料（如论文）；
3.  Google Drive、Slack、Gmail 和 BioRxiv 的连接器；
4.  用于运行专用蛋白设计与折叠模型的 GPU 访问权；
5.  在限定时间内不设 token 与子 agent 预算上限，并开启 fast 模式。

bilingual.en:
After giving Claude the prompt, we left the model to execute autonomously. We provided no additional scientific, technical, or operational guidance after we initiated the campaigns.

Our only involvement was granting access approvals (such as network access requests) and monitoring the infrastructure to ensure the sessions were running. Claude conducted all of the work that goes into designing a binder, which can take a human operator weeks. It chose where on each protein target to design against; generated candidate structures and sequences by orchestrating several structure design, sequence design, and co-folding models (models that predict the structure of a protein, together with whatever it binds, in a single pass); ran the designs through multiple cycles of _in silico_ optimization; and computationally screened for novel, diverse candidates that would express, stay soluble, and bind.
bilingual.zh:
把 prompt 给了 Claude 之后，我们就放手让模型**自主执行**。战役启动后，我们没有再提供任何额外的科学、技术或操作层面的指导。

我们唯一的介入是批准访问请求（比如网络访问申请），以及监控基础设施确保会话在正常运行。**设计一个结合剂所需的全部工作都是 Claude 自己做的**——这些工作换成人类操作者可能要数周。它自己选择在每个靶蛋白的哪个位点做设计；通过编排多个结构设计模型、序列设计模型和共折叠模型（co-folding model，即在一次前向过程中同时预测蛋白及其结合对象结构的模型）来生成候选结构与序列；把设计送入多轮**计算机模拟（in silico）优化**；并在计算层面筛选出新颖、多样、且能表达、能保持可溶、能结合的候选。

bilingual.en:
For each of the 15 targets, we asked Claude to design 30 protein binders. Claude did this by operating publicly available specialist protein design and co-folding models that the field already uses. Claude’s designs were then sent to Adaptyv Bio and Twist Bioscience to validate.

Claude successfully orchestrates multiple open-source protein design models, generating binders with high success rates and high affinities. a) Sankey diagram depicting Claude’s combinations of structure design, sequence design, and optimization rounds. b, c) Claude designs binders with hit rates over 20%, including high-affinity binders, for all structure design methods with at least 100 ordered designs.
bilingual.zh:
对这 15 个靶点中的每一个，我们都要求 Claude 设计 30 个蛋白结合剂。Claude 是通过驱动该领域已在使用的、公开可得的专业蛋白设计与共折叠模型来完成的。随后 Claude 的设计被送往 Adaptyv Bio 和 Twist Bioscience 做验证。

> 图注：Claude 成功编排了多个开源蛋白设计模型，生成了高成功率、高亲和力的结合剂。a) 桑基图展示了 Claude 对结构设计、序列设计与优化轮次的组合方式。b、c) 对于所有至少下单了 100 个设计的结构设计方法，Claude 设计出的结合剂命中率都超过 20%，其中包括高亲和力结合剂。

bilingual.en:
## **Claude’s performance on the targets**

By the end of this effort, we produced 354 binders against 14 of 15 targets using a total of 1,320 designs. This represents a significant contribution to the total corpus of publicly available _de novo_ protein designs; for example, the two largest collections, [proteinbase.com](https://proteinbase.com/) and the collection curated by [Overath et al.](https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2025.08.14.670059v2), consist of approximately 770 binders out of 5,700 designs against 40 targets. Below, we share three examples highlighting Claude’s capabilities, and one showing its limitations. You can find more detail in our technical report ([link](https://www-cdn.anthropic.com/30bf50e22a01388bb29bf077ee3f244531594b7a.pdf)).
bilingual.zh:
## **Claude 在各靶点上的表现**

到这项工作结束时，我们用总共 **1,320 个设计**，针对 15 个靶点中的 14 个产出了 **354 个结合剂**。这对公开可得的 *de novo* 蛋白设计总语料是一次显著贡献；作为对照，现有两个最大的合集——[proteinbase.com](https://proteinbase.com/) 以及 [Overath 等人](https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2025.08.14.670059v2)整理的合集——合计约是针对 40 个靶点的 5,700 个设计中产出约 770 个结合剂。下面我们分享三个凸显 Claude 能力的例子，以及一个暴露其局限的例子。更多细节见我们的技术报告（[链接](https://www-cdn.anthropic.com/30bf50e22a01388bb29bf077ee3f244531594b7a.pdf)）。

bilingual.en:
#### **Claude’s designs are competitive with entries in Adaptyv Bio’s protein design competition**

We found that for the targets Adaptyv Bio has run competitions for, Claude performs at or beyond the level of the top participants on both hit rate and affinity. Against RBX1 (a small protein that drives the targeted destruction of specific regulatory proteins), Mythos Preview in single-target mode achieved a 40% hit rate, compared to a 3.7% hit rate among participants. Its top-ranked design was a high-affinity binder that outperformed the winning design, which was among 245 designs entered.

Claude designs binders against RBX1 with state-of-the-art affinity, and routinely surpasses hit rates recorded in Adaptyv Bio’s protein design competitions.
bilingual.zh:
#### **Claude 的设计与 Adaptyv Bio 蛋白设计竞赛的参赛作品旗鼓相当**

我们发现，在 Adaptyv Bio 举办过竞赛的那些靶点上，Claude 在**命中率和亲和力两项上都达到或超过了顶尖参赛者的水平**。针对 RBX1（一种驱动特定调控蛋白定向降解的小蛋白），单靶点模式下的 Mythos Preview 取得了 **40% 的命中率，而参赛者的命中率是 3.7%**。它排名第一的设计是一个高亲和力结合剂，表现优于那次竞赛 245 份参赛设计中的获胜作品。

> 图注：Claude 针对 RBX1 设计出了达到当前最高水平（state-of-the-art）亲和力的结合剂，并常规性地超过 Adaptyv Bio 蛋白设计竞赛中记录的命中率。

bilingual.en:
#### **Claude designs species cross-reactive binders against TNFα**, **a challenging, therapeutically relevant target**

Interestingly, Opus 4.8, and not Mythos Preview, succeeds on TNFα, a target multiple expert groups have struggled with. TNFα is a signaling protein released by the immune system to trigger inflammation, and blocking it is the therapeutic basis for some of the most impactful drugs ever made, including Humira. It’s a challenging target to design against because of its multimeric structure, which requires targeting a binding site in the groove formed by two proteins. Although Mythos Preview was unsuccessful, Opus 4.8 designed multiple binders, including some that worked across species, binding human, cynomolgus monkey, and mouse TNFα, which is important for conducting animal studies. We’re not sure why Opus 4.8 was successful on this target and Mythos Preview was not. When we assess our models' capabilities, we do so holistically. Given the inherent complexity of protein design, it’s unsurprising that there would be specific areas where an overall less capable model could still outperform one that was generally more capable.

Opus 4.8 successfully designed de novo binders against TNFα, some of which were cross-reactive and bound human, cynomolgus monkey, and mouse TNFα.
bilingual.zh:
#### **Claude 针对 TNFα 设计出跨物种交叉反应的结合剂——一个高难度且具治疗价值的靶点**

有意思的是，在 TNFα 上成功的是 Opus 4.8 而不是 Mythos Preview——这个靶点让多个专家团队都栽过跟头。TNFα 是免疫系统释放、用来触发炎症的信号蛋白，阻断它是史上最具影响力的一些药物（包括修美乐 Humira）的治疗学基础。它之所以难设计，是因为其**多聚体结构**——需要瞄准由两个蛋白共同形成的凹槽中的结合位点。虽然 Mythos Preview 没有成功，Opus 4.8 却设计出了多个结合剂，其中一些能跨物种起效，可结合人、食蟹猴和小鼠的 TNFα——这对开展动物实验很重要。**我们并不确定为什么 Opus 4.8 在这个靶点上成功而 Mythos Preview 没有。**我们评估模型能力时是整体性评估的。鉴于蛋白设计固有的复杂性，在某些特定领域出现「整体上能力较弱的模型反而胜过整体更强的模型」，并不令人意外。

> 图注：Opus 4.8 成功设计出针对 TNFα 的 de novo 结合剂，其中一些具备交叉反应性，可结合人、食蟹猴和小鼠的 TNFα。

bilingual.en:
#### **Claude designs fold-diverse binders with β-sheets**

Most computationally designed binders are bundles of α-helices, a protein secondary structure consisting of coils. β-sheets, in which extended strands of amino acids must line up side by side, are harder to design and more prone to misfolding and aggregation (when protein molecules stick to each other instead of staying separate and properly folded). Claude designed 15 confirmed binders across six targets that contain at least 20% β-strand, demonstrating its ability to reason about protein structure.

Claude successfully designed 15 binders (across 10 distinct backbones) with β-sheets against six targets.
bilingual.zh:
#### **Claude 设计出含 β 折叠片的折叠多样性结合剂**

大多数计算设计出的结合剂都是 **α 螺旋**的捆束——一种由盘旋构成的蛋白二级结构。而 **β 折叠片**（β-sheet，其中延展的氨基酸链必须并排对齐）更难设计，也更容易发生错误折叠和聚集（即蛋白分子彼此粘连，而不是各自分离并正确折叠）。Claude 在六个靶点上设计出了 15 个已确认的结合剂，其中 β 链占比至少 20%——这展示了它对蛋白结构进行推理的能力。

> 图注：Claude 成功针对六个靶点设计出 15 个含 β 折叠片的结合剂（分布在 10 个不同的骨架上）。

bilingual.en:
#### **Claude struggled against some targets**

Certain targets remained a challenge for Claude, including BBF-14 and maltose-binding protein (MBP). BBF-14 is a β-barrel-shaped protein that does not exist in nature: it was itself [_de novo_ designed](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-024-07601-y), and it is now used as a benchmark for binder design precisely because of its novelty. MBP’s structure is also especially difficult. MBP is a large, flexible bacterial protein with a smooth, water-loving surface that makes it a good lab reagent. This leaves a binder very little to grab on to. Claude still managed to produce three independent BBF-14 binders—one from each design arm, and each built on a different backbone—with modest (sub-micromolar to micromolar) affinities. Against MBP, however, none of the 90 designs was confirmed to have bound to the target, although one demonstrated a weak, reproducible binding signal.

Claude had limited success in designing protein binders against BBF-14, a de novo designed beta barrel, and maltose binding protein (MBP).

To better understand how well Claude performed across these design campaigns, we intend to follow our experiments with more extensive characterization to confirm our hit rates and affinity measurements. In the meantime, we are sharing the prompts we used for these campaigns, as well as all _in vitro_ and _in silico_ data we generated.7
bilingual.zh:
#### **Claude 在某些靶点上吃了瘪**

有些靶点对 Claude 仍是难关，包括 BBF-14 和麦芽糖结合蛋白（MBP）。BBF-14 是一种自然界中并不存在的 β 桶状蛋白：它本身就是被 [*de novo* 设计](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-024-07601-y)出来的，如今正因其新颖性而被用作结合剂设计的基准。MBP 的结构也格外棘手——它是一种大而柔性的细菌蛋白，表面光滑亲水，因而是很好的实验室试剂，但这也让结合剂几乎无处下手。即便如此，Claude 仍设法产出了三个独立的 BBF-14 结合剂——每个设计臂各出一个，且分别构建在不同骨架上——亲和力属中等水平（亚微摩尔到微摩尔量级）。而针对 MBP，90 个设计中**没有一个被确认结合到靶点**，尽管其中一个表现出微弱但可重复的结合信号。

> 图注：针对 BBF-14（一种 de novo 设计的 β 桶蛋白）和麦芽糖结合蛋白（MBP），Claude 设计蛋白结合剂的成功程度有限。

为了更好地了解 Claude 在这些设计战役中的真实表现，我们打算在实验之后进行更广泛的表征分析，以确认我们的命中率和亲和力测量结果。与此同时，我们正在公开这些战役所用的 prompt，以及我们产生的全部体外（*in vitro*）与计算模拟（*in silico*）数据。[^7]

bilingual.en:
#### **Agentic biological discovery is dual-use**

The uplift provided by the increasingly autonomous research capabilities of AI models will undoubtedly speed the development of human therapies and fundamental scientific discoveries. However, such capabilities are also dual-use: without robust safety measures, they could enable bad actors to perform dangerous research, such as the development of bioweapons. As we work to deliver these capabilities safely via trusted access programs, protein design and other dual-use research biology capabilities [remain unavailable](https://www.anthropic.com/news/improving-fable-5-s-biology-safeguards) for general access in Claude Fable 5. However, as you’ll see below, our Opus-class models are capable of remarkable scientific work.
bilingual.zh:
#### **Agentic 生物学发现是双重用途的**

AI 模型日益自主的研究能力所带来的增益，无疑会加速人类疗法的开发和基础科学发现。然而，这类能力同时也是**双重用途（dual-use）**的：在缺乏稳健安全措施的情况下，它们可能让恶意行为者得以开展危险研究，比如生物武器开发。在我们努力通过可信访问计划安全交付这些能力的同时，蛋白设计及其他双重用途研究型生物学能力在 Claude Fable 5 中[仍不对通用访问开放](https://www.anthropic.com/news/improving-fable-5-s-biology-safeguards)。不过，正如下文所示，我们的 Opus 级模型同样能完成相当出色的科学工作。

bilingual.en:
## **Claude runs the analytical chemistry workflow**

Where the protein binder campaign tested Claude’s ability to design new molecules, the second experiment tested its ability to interpret measurements of molecules already made. Characterizing a compound is cumbersome work; much like protein design, it requires chemists to perform many rounds of measurement, analysis, and iteration. For example, every time a chemist creates a molecule, they must establish whether it is what they intended to produce and how pure it is. This is typically done with nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectroscopy. An NMR spectrum is a series of peaks, each corresponding to a hydrogen atom, or a group of equivalent hydrogens, somewhere in the molecule. The location of the peaks shows chemists what each hydrogen atom is attached to, and the size of the peak shows how many hydrogens it represents. Confirming a structure is one of the most time-consuming steps in synthetic chemistry; for every compound, a chemist has to match each peak in the spectrum to an atom in the proposed structure by hand.
bilingual.zh:
## **Claude 跑通分析化学工作流**

如果说蛋白结合剂战役测的是 Claude **设计新分子**的能力，那么第二项实验测的就是它**解读已合成分子的测量数据**的能力。表征一个化合物是件繁琐的活儿；和蛋白设计很像，它要求化学家进行多轮测量、分析和迭代。举例来说，化学家每合成一个分子，都必须确认它是否就是自己想要的产物、以及纯度如何。这通常靠**核磁共振（NMR）波谱**来完成。一张 NMR 谱图是一系列峰，每个峰对应分子中某处的一个氢原子或一组等价氢。峰的位置告诉化学家每个氢原子连在什么上面，峰的大小则显示它代表多少个氢。确认结构是合成化学中最耗时的步骤之一；对每一个化合物，化学家都得**手工**把谱图中的每个峰与拟定结构中的某个原子一一对应上。

bilingual.en: The other technique, used mainly to assess purity, is liquid chromatography–mass spectrometry (LC-MS), which first separates the sample into its individual components as they flow through a column, then records how much of each is present based on its ultraviolet absorbance, before measuring the molecular mass of each one. For both techniques, the instrument run itself takes only a few minutes (two to three for a routine proton NMR spectrum; about 10 for an LC-MS run). The tedious part is analyzing the output. After NMR and LC-MS are run, each instrument produces a raw file in the manufacturer’s own format that is meant to be opened in that manufacturer’s (or other specialist) software.8
bilingual.zh: 另一项技术主要用于评估纯度，即**液相色谱-质谱联用（LC-MS）**：它先在样品流过色谱柱时把其中各组分分离开，再根据紫外吸收记录每种组分的含量，最后测定每一种的分子质量。对这两项技术而言，仪器本身跑一次只需几分钟（常规质子 NMR 谱两到三分钟；LC-MS 约十分钟）。真正冗长的是**分析输出**。NMR 和 LC-MS 跑完后，每台仪器都会产出一个厂商私有格式的原始文件，本来只能用该厂商（或其他专业）软件打开。[^8]

bilingual.en:
Given how painstaking it is to process and interpret these files, we wanted to see how a generally available model such as Claude Opus 5 would perform at this task.9 Supplied with only a contract lab’s raw files for a routine quality-control sample and a short plain-language prompt,10 with no vendor software and no operator, Claude, working within Claude Science, returned processed NMR and LC-MS results in 23 and 19 minutes, respectively, working in parallel. Its results matched the lab’s own processing—hydrogen counts per peak were within 0.08 ¹H of the lab’s, and its purity was measured at 96.4% versus the 96.33% of the lab.

What the lab sent, and what Claude returned 23 minutes later. (left) The raw NMR signal as it comes off the instrument; (right) the processed spectrum, with each peak located and its hydrogens counted.
bilingual.zh:
鉴于处理和解读这些文件有多么费劲，我们想看看像 Claude Opus 5 这样**通用可得的模型**在这项任务上表现如何。[^9]在只拿到某家合同实验室针对一个常规质控样品的原始文件、外加一段简短的大白话 prompt[^10] 的情况下——没有厂商软件，也没有操作员——在 Claude Science 中工作的 Claude 分别用 **23 分钟和 19 分钟**并行返回了处理好的 NMR 与 LC-MS 结果。它的结果与实验室自己的处理结果吻合：**每个峰的氢原子计数与实验室的差距在 0.08 ¹H 以内，纯度测得 96.4%，而实验室是 96.33%。**

> 图注：实验室发来的东西，以及 23 分钟后 Claude 返回的东西。（左）刚从仪器上下来的原始 NMR 信号；（右）处理后的谱图，每个峰都被定位、其氢原子数量都被计出。

bilingual.en: For the NMR data, Claude converted the raw data from the instrument into a calibrated spectrum and a table of 18 peaks, with a hydrogen count for each. Next, as a chemist would, it flagged four broad peaks as hydrogens that were probably attached to nitrogen or oxygen. It then proposed the standard check: add heavy water to the NMR sample, which swaps those hydrogens out so their peaks shrink or vanish. (Independently, the lab had run this same check three days after the first measurement.) Given the raw file from the heavy-water run, Claude quantified what had changed in the data, caught and corrected an overstatement in its first reading (its first pass reported that all four flagged peaks had disappeared, but its own self-check showed that only two had), and arrived at the same conclusion as the lab’s operator.
bilingual.zh: 对于 NMR 数据，Claude 把仪器出的原始数据转换成了一张校准过的谱图和一张含 18 个峰的表格，并给出每个峰的氢原子数。接着，它像化学家会做的那样，把其中四个宽峰标记为「可能连接在氮或氧上的氢」。然后它提出了那项标准检验：往 NMR 样品里加重水，把这些氢置换掉，让它们的峰缩小或消失。（在此之前，实验室已在首次测量三天后独立地跑过同一项检验。）拿到重水实验的原始文件后，Claude 量化了数据中发生的变化，**发现并纠正了自己第一次解读中的夸大**（它第一遍报告说四个被标记的峰全部消失，但它自己的自检显示只有两个消失），最终得出了与实验室操作员相同的结论。

bilingual.en:
(left) The LC-MS run as it arrived, as a file of raw bytes in a format only the manufacturer’s software is meant to read. (right) The chromatogram Claude recovered from it 19 minutes later: a single component at 4.34 minutes carrying 96.4% of the UV signal, with a molecular mass of 504 daltons.

The LC-MS instrument files use an undocumented vendor format. Claude worked out how the data was encoded, then confirmed it had read the file correctly by reproducing the instrument's own recorded totals for all 2,664 scans before analyzing anything. It then delivered all the outputs a chemist would expect: the separation trace, mass and UV spectra, a purity table, the compound’s molecular mass, as well as reusable code for reading such files, alongside its own list of caveats about the trustworthiness of the results (it noted, for example, that this class of instrument gives the mass only to the nearest whole unit).
bilingual.zh:
> 图注：（左）刚送达时的 LC-MS 运行数据——一个原始字节文件，其格式本应只有厂商软件才能读取。（右）19 分钟后 Claude 从中还原出的色谱图：4.34 分钟处有单一组分，承载了 96.4% 的紫外信号，分子质量为 504 道尔顿。

LC-MS 仪器文件使用的是一种**无公开文档的厂商私有格式**。Claude 自行推断出了数据的编码方式，然后在开始任何分析之前，先通过复现仪器自己记录的全部 2,664 次扫描的总计值，确认自己正确读取了该文件。随后它交付了化学家会期待的全部产物：分离图谱、质谱与紫外谱、纯度表、化合物分子质量，以及一份可复用的、用于读取此类文件的代码，同时还附上了它自己列出的、关于结果可信度的一系列**注意事项**（例如它指出，这一类仪器只能给出精确到最接近整数单位的质量）。

bilingual.en:
Ordinarily, a chemist does all this analysis by hand. This typically takes half an hour to an hour per sample for a therapeutically relevant small molecule (the lab’s own records show about two minutes of hands-on processing per NMR spectrum, with the LC-MS report following about two hours after the sample was loaded onto the instrument). Claude Science processed and interpreted both files in parallel within those 25 minutes. Claude also produced a written report in that time, whereas the lab’s finished report for this sample arrived four days after the first spectrum was acquired—a fairly standard lag time given that they analyze molecules one at a time, and work may crop up in between.

Beyond the increased efficiency, Claude’s run also showed a degree of scientific judgment, for instance in proposing the very same follow-up experiment the contract lab had independently run. As these models continue to improve, we expect Claude’s scientific judgment to become more acute.

To try this yourself in [Claude Science](https://claude.com/product/claude-science), give Claude a raw NMR or LC-MS file and ask the model to confirm the compound’s identity and purity.
bilingual.zh:
通常情况下，这些分析全靠化学家手工完成。对一个具治疗相关性的小分子，每个样品一般要花半小时到一小时（实验室自己的记录显示，每张 NMR 谱约需两分钟的动手处理时间，而 LC-MS 报告则在样品上机后约两小时才出）。Claude Science 在那 25 分钟内**并行**处理并解读了这两个文件。Claude 还在同一时间内产出了一份书面报告；而实验室对这个样品的成稿报告，是在首张谱图采集完成**四天后**才送达的——考虑到他们是一个分子一个分子地分析、中途还会插进别的活儿，这个延迟其实相当标准。

除了效率提升之外，Claude 这次运行还展现出了一定程度的**科学判断力**，比如它提出的后续实验，恰恰与合同实验室独立跑过的那一项完全相同。随着这些模型持续改进，我们预期 Claude 的科学判断力会变得更加敏锐。

想自己在 [Claude Science](https://claude.com/product/claude-science) 里试一下，可以给 Claude 一个原始 NMR 或 LC-MS 文件，让模型确认化合物的身份与纯度。

bilingual.en:
#### **Conclusion**

Both of the examples above demonstrate how AI models can accelerate research in the life sciences by reducing the expertise, cost, and time involved in scientific discovery. In chemistry, Claude is automating analyses that chemists have historically done by hand. In protein design, Claude can execute binder design campaigns end-to-end with minimal input, producing binders that match or surpass the best previously published designs.

Protein minibinders are not a standard therapeutic modality for drugs and even for the common drug modalities, such as monoclonal antibodies and small molecules, designing a high-affinity binder is just the first step in the process of generating a drug-like molecule. However, we view this work as foundational, and are extending it so that Claude can run the entire development process end-to-end across all drug modalities.
bilingual.zh:
#### **结论**

上面这两个例子都展示了 AI 模型如何通过降低科学发现所需的专业门槛、成本与时间来加速生命科学研究。在化学领域，Claude 正在把化学家历来手工完成的分析自动化。在蛋白设计领域，Claude 能在极少输入的情况下**端到端执行完整的结合剂设计战役**，产出达到或超过此前已发表最佳设计的结合剂。

蛋白微结合剂并不是药物的标准治疗模态；而即便对单克隆抗体、小分子这类常见药物模态来说，设计出一个高亲和力结合剂也只是生成类药分子这一流程中的**第一步**。不过我们把这项工作视为基础性的，并正在将其延伸——目标是让 Claude 能够跨所有药物模态、端到端地跑完整个研发流程。

quotes.en: Of the 15 targets we designed against, Claude successfully designed binders against 14 of them.
quotes.zh: 在我们设计针对的 15 个靶点中，Claude 成功为其中 14 个设计出了结合剂。

quotes.en: After giving Claude the prompt, we left the model to execute autonomously. We provided no additional scientific, technical, or operational guidance after we initiated the campaigns.
quotes.zh: 把 prompt 给了 Claude 之后，我们就放手让模型自主执行。战役启动后，我们没有再提供任何额外的科学、技术或操作层面的指导。

quotes.en: We're not sure why Opus 4.8 was successful on this target and Mythos Preview was not. When we assess our models' capabilities, we do so holistically. Given the inherent complexity of protein design, it's unsurprising that there would be specific areas where an overall less capable model could still outperform one that was generally more capable.
quotes.zh: 我们并不确定为什么 Opus 4.8 在这个靶点上成功、而 Mythos Preview 没有。我们评估模型能力时是整体性地评估的。鉴于蛋白设计固有的复杂性，在某些具体领域里，一个整体上较弱的模型仍然跑赢一个总体更强的模型，并不令人意外。

quotes.en: The LC-MS instrument files use an undocumented vendor format. Claude worked out how the data was encoded, then confirmed it had read the file correctly by reproducing the instrument's own recorded totals for all 2,664 scans before analyzing anything.
quotes.zh: LC-MS 仪器文件使用的是一种无公开文档的厂商私有格式。Claude 自行推断出数据的编码方式，随后在动手分析之前，先复现了仪器自己记录的全部 2,664 次扫描的合计值，以此确认自己读对了文件。

quotes.en: Claude quantified what had changed in the data, caught and corrected an overstatement in its first reading (its first pass reported that all four flagged peaks had disappeared, but its own self-check showed that only two had), and arrived at the same conclusion as the lab's operator.
quotes.zh: Claude 量化了数据中发生的变化，发现并纠正了自己第一次解读中的夸大（第一遍它报告四个标记峰全部消失，但它自己的复核显示实际只消失了两个），最终得出了与实验室操作员相同的结论。

quotes.en: Such capabilities are also dual-use: without robust safety measures, they could enable bad actors to perform dangerous research, such as the development of bioweapons.
quotes.zh: 这类能力同时也是双重用途的：在缺乏稳健安全措施的情况下，它们可能让恶意行为者得以开展危险研究，比如生物武器开发。

quotes.en: Designing a high-affinity binder is just the first step in the process of generating a drug-like molecule.
quotes.zh: 设计出一个高亲和力结合剂，只是生成类药分子这一流程中的第一步。

secondaryReads.source: Adaptyv Bio《Case study: Benchmarking Claude's protein designs in the wet lab》
secondaryReads.pov: 做湿实验那一方的自述，比 Anthropic 原文多两个关键细节。其一是**盲测**：Anthropic 送来的是匿名化设计列表，Adaptyv 事先不知道哪条序列出自哪个模型。其二是原文没强调的表达率——**1,320 个设计里 95% 成功表达**，这个数字追平了有数百名专家参与的 EGFR 竞赛的最佳表达率。他们还给出更锋利的对照口径：把竞赛结果限定为 de novo 微结合剂后，Claude 的设计在六场竞赛中会赢下五场。最后点出本次实验的根本局限：这是一次**开环（open-loop）**实验，下一步才是闭环——agent 提出一批、拿到实验数据、从成败中学习、再决定下一批。

secondaryReads.source: The Next Web《Anthropic says Claude designed working protein binders》
secondaryReads.pov: 提供了阅读厂商自研报告时该有的克制。它把归属关系挑明：**头条数字全部是 Anthropic 自报的，未经外部同行评审**——两家外部实验室只承担了结合剂的物理测试，并不构成对方法与结论的独立审查；Anthropic 自称是「整体性」评估，并承诺后续再发更多表征数据来确认这些数字。它也点出一个原文轻描淡写的事实：正因为这类能力是双重用途的，蛋白设计等敏感生物学任务在 Claude Fable 5（其最强模型）上仍处于封禁状态，公司改以受审核的科学家访问计划来放行。

secondaryReads.source: Anthropic 技术报告《Autonomous de novo protein binder design with Claude》
secondaryReads.pov: 博客正文之外的完整技术底稿，含博客里被压缩掉的自我限定。最值得注意的是数据污染的自陈：在六个有公开竞赛的靶点中，**其中四场（EGFR、TREM2、RBX1、Nipah G）的竞赛结果在 Claude 设计期间是可获取的**，甚至就在协议提示词附带的阅读清单上——这直接削弱了「超越参赛者」这一比较的强度。报告还给出另一个口径的命中率：全部设计 27%，而每个靶点排名第一的设计为 49%、前五名 44%、前十名 39%，说明模型自身的排序能力本身就构成了显著增益。
